script:
--https://discord.gg/CQYycadt6z

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Remotes = RS:WaitForChild("StimulationRemotes")
local SaveRemote = Remotes:WaitForChild("SaveData")

local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
local oldNamecall = mt.__namecall
setreadonly(mt, false)

mt.__namecall = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
    local args = {...}
    local method = getnamecallmethod()

    -- Hooking the save data (OP method)
    if method == "FireServer" and self == SaveRemote then
        print(">> Yoinking save packet... finna cook 😈 <<")
        
        local wrapper = args[1]
        if type(wrapper) == "table" then
             local realData = wrapper[1] or wrapper 
             
             if realData and realData["Stimulation"] then
                 -- Injecting stats fr
                 realData["Stimulation"] = 100000000 -- 100M
                 realData["Gems"] = 50000
                 realData["Rebirths"] = 100
                 
                 warn("Sheesh! Data spoofed successfully 🥶")
             end
        end
        
        return oldNamecall(self, unpack(args))
    end
    
    -- Force leaderboards to update
    if method == "FireServer" and self.Name == "UpdateLeaderstats" then
        args[1] = 100000000 -- You can put any number
        return oldNamecall(self, unpack(args))
    end

    return oldNamecall(self, ...)
end)
